'''Red squad''' or '''Red squadron''' was a military unit of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and a part of [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]. They used red armpatches for identification. [[Bakki Sourthol]] commanded the unit.<ref name="CP" /> Red squad had at least two [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] assigned to it.<ref name="Godking">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Star Wars Campaign Pack}}</ref>
